result.title: Fed-MAPTrack: Federated Modality-aware Prompt Tuning for RGB-X Tracking
result.summary: RGB-X tracking complements RGB appearance with thermal, depth, or event observations, but centralized training requires collecting multimodal videos at a single location. Federated training keeps raw videos local, but sensor heterogeneity can create a mismatch between parameter-sharing domains and the clients contributing to them. This mismatch is particularly relevant when RGB-only clients coexist with sensor-equipped clients: their RGB observations remain useful, but they provide no auxiliary measurements for learning sensor-dependent interactions. We propose Fed-MAPTrack, a modality-aware federated prompt tuning framework for RGB-X tracking. The pretrained tracking backbone and prediction head are frozen, and clients optimize and exchange only prompt-related parameters. The server aggregates RGB-shared parameters globally and maintains separate thermal, event, and depth banks for auxiliary-specific, fusion, and normalization parameters. Selective participation retains RGB-only clients' contributions to the global RGB bank while excluding their fusion and normalization updates from modality-specific aggregation. Across three matched training repetitions under a fixed client partition, Fed-MAPTrack improves the mean FedAvg scores by 2.35 AUC points on LasHeR, 3.45 SR points on VisEvent, and 2.11 F-score points on DepthTrack. Among the nine evaluated methods, it achieves the highest mean thermal AUC and depth F-score, while its mean event SR is 0.07 points below that of Independent FL. Controlled ablations show that extending the bucketing scope without a compatible participation rule can reduce performance. These results highlight the need to jointly define the sharing domain and eligible contributors for each parameter group.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Fed-MAPTrack，在冻结跟踪主干与预测头的前提下，按模态（RGB 共享、热红外/事件/深度专属）分组交换 prompt 参数，并设计选择性联邦参与规则以减少传感器异构带来的聚合错配。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是 RGB-X 跟踪的联邦 prompt 调优，核心在隐私约束下的参数共享域与客户端参与规则，不涉及推理期 latent 状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，prompt 分桶仅服务通信与异构聚合，缺少可供核查的 LVR 线索。
